title: 第十章 老大第十一章 感动第十二章 顶上了
content_zh:
挂了电话。
林昆大摇大摆的走进了别墅区，什么国安局特别行动处的，这些在别人眼里神秘而又深不可测的组织，他根本就不放在心上，只是令他想不到的是，这一切的安排竟都出自于燕京城里朱家朱老爷子之手。
而更令他想象不到的是，他那从小就孤儿的身份，竟与燕京朱家有着千丝万缕的联系——燕京朱家，那可是华夏红色政权开国的元勋世家，历经数十年的发展壮大，早已经是燕京城里中流砥柱的四大家族之一。
林昆回到了别墅，老捷达停在门口，楚静瑶不在家，偌大的房子一个人待着，实在是无聊，他本来琢磨着开着车出去兜兜风，可眼下要紧的任务还没有完成——熟悉别墅的地形，毕竟以后要在这儿工作很久。
楼上楼下的转了一圈。
别墅一共三层，额外还有一个地下室，一楼主要是厨房、餐厅和客厅，二楼是卧室和休闲的地方，三楼是一个全景的阁楼，摆着一张大床，白天躺在床上可以看蓝天，到了夜里可以看星空，地下室是藏酒窖。
推开酒窖木门的一刹那，林昆着实被惊呆了，这间酒窖至少一百个平方，整齐的摆开了八个高低不一的酒架，每个酒架上又都摆满了各式各样的酒，随便抄起一瓶一看，都是价格不菲的世界名酒，什么轩诗尼、茅台、人头马、XO、伏特加、白兰地、威士忌的……应有尽有。
“我勒个去……”
林昆惊叹一声，本以为这酒窖就是个摆设，没想到里面的料这么足。
“不行，我得压压惊。”
林昆咧嘴笑道，就近拎起一瓶72年的轩诗尼，啵的一声打开，对着瓶口咕咚咕咚的就灌了两口，然后吧唧吧唧嘴：“嗯……口感还不错呵。”
不得不说，这厮脸皮实在太厚了，想喝人家楚静瑶私藏的名酒也就罢了，还找了那么一个冠冕堂皇的理由——压惊，狗屁呢。而且再说了，他那喝惯了漠北烈酒的舌根，真能喝出人家72年轩诗尼的口感？扯淡吧！
在酒窖里转悠了一圈，这厮又拎着酒瓶到别墅外，还极为不惭的点上了根大红河，灌一口酒，吐一个烟圈，正常人喝名酒都是高脚杯配雪茄，讲究的是一份高雅与享受，这厮喝名酒的架势倒像是在喝矿泉水……
咕咚咕咚。
哎，这也忒特么的暴殄天物了吧。
别墅的前后都有小院，用小栅栏围着，有着一股田园小清新的感觉，值得一提的是在车库的旁边，有着一小块空着的菜地，大约五六十个平方。
这菜地是昔日开发商的卖点，每栋别墅都有，专门用来给业主们养花种菜感受田园生活的，只可惜目前来看，几乎每家的菜地都是空着的。
林昆踩了踩脚下的泥土，心里头琢磨着，这难得的一块菜地，不种点什么太可惜了。
不知不觉的已经中午了，阳光透过窗户照进办公室，楚静瑶批示完了桌上的最后一份文件，抬起头望向窗外，远远的能看到天楚国际大厦的塔尖，那是象征着中港市经济地标的建筑，三年前楚相国就走完了法律程序，将天楚国际大厦和天楚集团59%的股份转在了楚静瑶的名下，从法律意义上讲，天楚集团目前最大的股东是楚静瑶，楚相国这个董事长只是替她打工的。
但是因为楚静瑶不肯原谅楚相国曾经犯下的过错，现在宁愿委身于一家小广告公司里当部门经理，也不愿意踏入那栋别人梦寐以求的大楼。

端起桌上泡着的柠檬水，小小的抿了一口，楚静瑶站起身来走到窗边，高挑的身影伫立在大落地窗前，窗外的阳光在她的身上勾勒出一圈曼妙的金边，透明的办公室大门后的男同事们顿时没了工作的心思，纷纷向他们的女神领导投来了炙热的目光，一时间竟看的有些痴了。
也不光男同事，许多的女同事也都纷纷看过来，炯炯的眼神里满是艳羡，面对如此的女神领导，她们的骨子里只有羡慕，生不起半点的妒忌。
楚静瑶握着手机有些犹豫，她不知道接下来这个电话该不该打，犹豫了一会儿后，她在心里轻叹一声：“算了，就当是为了儿子了。”
电话拨了出去，手机上显示着：臭流氓，是林昆的号码，楚静瑶本来想问问他在警察局里有没有出来，结果电话刚响了一声，就被接通了。
“喂，老婆……”
电话里传来了林昆轻佻的声音，楚静瑶一听，顿时黛眉一皱，命令喝止道：“闭嘴，谁是你老婆！”缓了一下，又语气严厉的接着道：“林先生，希望你能搞清楚状况，你是请来给我儿子当爸爸的，请你自重！”
“……”
楚静瑶说完，电话里变的一片安静，过了几秒钟，就在她以为是否掉线的时候，里面传来了一声很响亮的酒嗝，她眉头又是一蹙，问道：“林先生，明白么？”
content_en:
Hang up the phone.
Lin Kun swaggered into the villa area. He didn't care about the Special Operations Division of the National Security Bureau. These organizations were mysterious and unfathomable in the eyes of others. What he didn't expect was that all the arrangements were made by Mr. Zhu of the Zhu family in Yanjing City.
What was even more unimaginable to him was that his status as an orphan since he was a child was inextricably linked to the Zhu family of Yanjing - the Zhu family of Yanjing, which was the founding family of the Chinese red regime. After decades of development and growth, it had already become one of the four mainstay families in the city of Yanjing.
Lin Kun returned to the villa. The old Jetta was parked at the door. Chu Jingyao was not at home. It was really boring to be alone in such a big house. He originally thought about taking a car for a drive, but the important task at the moment was not completed yet - getting familiar with the terrain of the villa. After all, he would be working here for a long time in the future.
There was a circle upstairs and downstairs.
The villa has three floors in total, and there is an additional basement. The first floor is mainly the kitchen, dining room and living room. The second floor is the bedroom and leisure area. The third floor is a panoramic loft with a large bed. You can lie on the bed during the day and watch the blue sky and the stars at night. The basement is a wine cellar.
The moment he pushed open the wooden door of the wine cellar, Lin Kun was really stunned. This wine cellar was at least one hundred square meters, with eight wine racks of different heights neatly arranged. Each wine rack was filled with a variety of wines. When he picked up a bottle, he saw that they were all expensive world-famous wines, such as Henschini, Moutai, Remy Martin, XO, vodka, brandy, whiskey... everything.
"I'll choke you..."
Lin Kun exclaimed. He thought this wine cellar was just a decoration, but he didn't expect that there was so much material inside.
"No, I have to suppress my shock."
Lin Kun grinned and picked up a bottle of 1972 Henshine nearby. He opened it with a pop, took two sips at the mouth of the bottle, and then smacked his lips: "Well... the taste is pretty good."
I have to say that this guy is too shameless. He just wanted to drink Chu Jingyao's private collection of famous wines, and he also found a high-sounding reason - to suppress his shock. That's bullshit. And besides, can his tongue, which is used to drinking Mobei spirits, really taste like the 1972 Henschini? Nonsense!
After wandering around the wine cellar, this guy took the bottle to the outside of the villa. He even lit a red wine without shame, took a sip of wine, and blew out a smoke ring. Normal people drink famous wines from goblets and cigars. What matters is elegance and enjoyment. This guy drank famous wines as if he were drinking mineral water...
Gudong, gudong.
Hey, this is such a waste of natural resources.
There are small courtyards in the front and back of the villa, surrounded by small fences, giving it a refreshing pastoral feel. It is worth mentioning that next to the garage, there is a small empty vegetable plot, about fifty or sixty square meters.
This vegetable plot was the selling point of developers in the past. Every villa had it, and it was specially used for the owners to grow flowers and vegetables and experience pastoral life. Unfortunately, at present, almost every vegetable plot is empty.
Lin Kun stepped on the soil under his feet, thinking to himself that it would be a pity not to plant something in this rare vegetable plot.
Unknowingly, it was already noon, and the sun shone into the office through the window. Chu Jingyao finished instructing the last document on the table. She raised her head and looked out the window. She could see the spire of Tianchu International Building in the distance. It was a building that symbolized the economic landmark of China and Hong Kong. Chu Xiangguo completed the legal procedures a few years ago and transferred 59% of the shares of Tianchu International Building and Tianchu Group to Chu Jingyao's name. From a legal sense, the current largest shareholder of Tianchu Group is Chu Jingyao, and Chu Xiangguo, the chairman, only works for her.
But because Chu Jingyao refused to forgive Chu Xiangguo for the mistakes he had made, she now preferred to work as a department in a small advertising company.The manager is unwilling to step into the building that others covet.
Picking up the lemonade on the table and taking a sip, Chu Jingyao stood up and walked to the window. Her tall figure stood in front of the large floor-to-ceiling window. The sunlight outside the window outlined a graceful golden border on her body. The male colleagues behind the transparent office door suddenly lost their focus on work and cast scorching glances at their goddess leader. For a moment, they were a little obsessed.
Not only male colleagues, but also many female colleagues looked over, their bright eyes full of envy. Facing such a goddess leader, they only had envy in their bones and could not bear the slightest bit of jealousy.
Chu Jingyao held the phone with some hesitation. She didn't know whether she should make the next call. After hesitating for a while, she sighed softly in her heart: "Forget it, just think of it as for her son."
The phone was dialed, and the phone displayed: Rogue, it was Lin Kun's number. Chu Jingyao originally wanted to ask him if he had come out from the police station, but the phone just rang and was answered.
"Hey, wife..."
Lin Kun's frivolous voice came from the phone. When Chu Jingyao heard it, she frowned and ordered to stop: "Shut up, who is your wife!" After a moment, she then continued in a stern tone: "Mr. Lin, I hope you can understand the situation. You are here to be my son's father. Please respect yourself!"
"..."
After Chu Jingyao finished speaking, the phone became quiet. After a few seconds, just when she thought the call was disconnected, a loud burp came from the phone. She frowned again and asked: "Mr. Lin, do you understand?"
